notes.title: NAIAD - Update v1.0.19!
notes.content:
[h2]Hi![/h2]
[h3]We continue celebrating the Lunar New Year... with more news![/h3]

[h3]A friendly reminder! Don’t miss the chance to get NAIAD with a [b]20% discount[/b] for a limited time.[/h3]

[b]NEW LANGUAGES:[/b]
- Added 2 new languages: Traditional Chinese, Korean.
- Achievements and rich presence have also been updated to support these languages.
- I hope this update will allow more players from around the world to enjoy the story. :)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41481868/2cb2d4b7d6204cd5c2a82d13849869f6406a0ec8.png[/img]

[b]PATCH NOTES v1.0.19:[/b]
- Fixed an issue where fish were not properly progressing to the next level after being caught/recovered by the fisherman.
- Fixed missing fauna in Episode 13. You will be able to find a new fauna in this chapter.
- Adjusted the interaction radius for chickens and other ground fauna to make triggering interactions easier.
- Fixed a physics issue where humans grabbing objects (such as wood logs) would push Naiad far away in some cases.
- Minor bug fixes and general improvements.

[b]NEW COMMUNITY CONTENT:[/b]
- Added 15 trading cards and 6 badges to the Steam Points Shop.
- Also added 8 new profile backgrounds and 10 emoticons.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41481868/8445aaf4aac888b365be36388679d58b8bdd1080.png[/img]

[b]STEAM DECK:[/b]
- NAIAD is now officially verified and fully compatible with Steam Deck!
- Many players have shared that the game runs smoothly and flawlessly on Steam Deck.
- Enjoy exploring the river anytime, anywhere! ^^

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41481868/adce45684e7cff6bb7ec0c0d81155216069e9dfe.png[/img]

If you enjoyed NAIAD, please don't forget to leave a review. It helps me keep developing the game and allows more people to discover it. ❤
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41481868/2e11b664a4897972335fec8a7e33d1095763bf92.png[/img]
[i]Thank you so much for playing NAIAD and for your support![/i]
Elwin

notes.title: NAIAD: Over a month swimming through nature!
notes.content:
[h1]Hello![/h1]

[h3]First of all, I want to express my gratitude to everyone who has played Naiad since its release just over a month ago. 
Thank you all for being part of this milestone in my life! <3![/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41481868/d153deaced59b77d75fcf6a8e7e020e2e88a18ca.png[/img]

[h2]Words from the Community. [/h2]
It has been incredibly moving for me to read such beautiful words about my first game. Here are just a few of them:

— "An experience as serene as it is thrilling, a game that embraces the soul."  
— "Naiad reminded me of the beauty of simplicity and the importance of connecting with nature."  
— "Every detail of the game is full of life. I felt like part of the river."  
— "I can see the love, care, and dedication in every element of this game, and I value it so much."  
— "Spectacularly pleasing to the eye, the flow is seamless, and I adore the animals."  
— "The graphics, music, and gameplay are so beautiful they made me want to cry."  
— "Without a doubt, one of the best games of recent years, destined to be a new classic in the indie scene."  
— "An unforgettable experience full of subtle nuances to discover in every playthrough."  
— "It’s incredible that all this was made by just one person. 10/10."

[h3][i]Did you enjoy Naiad?[/i][/h3]
[i]I’d love to hear your thoughts! Every review helps me grow, improve, and bring this game in which I have poured all my heart, to more players. [/i]

[h2]New Updates.[/h2]
I’ve been hard at work to improve the experience, focusing on the feedback received:

[*] [b]Frog behavior[/b]: They’re even cuter now and will follow you wherever you go! 
[*] [b]Guitar puzzle:[/b] Now includes additional hints to solve it.
[*] Other minor fixes and improvements based on feedback.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41481868/fe972a495f519598cd099a55041a4b17f8759f59.png[/img]
[h2]Something Special is Coming... [/h2]
In just a few days, Naiad will celebrate something very special. I can’t reveal much (yet), but I recommend staying tuned.  

The next announcement will be something you won’t want to miss!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41481868/9a85def3b5dff39d08e5da80d190bb274da8aa94.png[/img]

[h2]Share Your Adventure.[/h2]
Haven’t left your [b]review[/b] yet? This is the perfect time to do so! Whether it’s a simple sentence or a full paragraph, your voice matters, and I’d love to read it.

- What did you love most?  
- Any special anecdotes?  
- How did the game make you feel?  

By sharing your thoughts, you inspire others to discover this unique game.  
It’s one of the best ways to support Naiad!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41481868/2e11b664a4897972335fec8a7e33d1095763bf92.png[/img]

[h3]Thank you for being part of this journey![/h3]
I’ll be back with more news soon... ^^

[i]Sincerely,[/i]
Elwin

[*] Other minor fixes and improvements based on feedback.

notes.title: Week 1 - Update!
notes.content:
[h2]Hi![/h2]

[h3]It’s been 7 days since the launch of NAIAD! Over the past week, I’ve been fully focused on addressing your valuable feedback and lovely comments, quickly fixing bugs with small patches so you can continue the game as soon as possible.[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41481868/93808c8394f91418db1e91803ccfe024ddc51dad.jpg[/img]

[h3]Since the launch, I have made 6 patches! These are some of the improvements:[/h3]

[b]The most common fixes were related to achievements and collectibles:[/b]

[*]Ep5: Missing Poem 1.
[*]"Fish Master", "Duck Master" achievements.
[*]"Oceanid" achievement.
[*]"Guardian of the River" platinum achievement.
[*]Some glitched fauna: Bear, Crocodile, Fox, etc.
[*]Fishes not following Naiad in Ep11-4 due to a pathfinding bug.

—

[b]I have also made some design improvements and added new options:[/b]

[*]Ep6.2 - Windmill / Gate: I’ve improved this puzzle so it’s now easier to understand what needs to be done to open the gate.
[*]New "Sharpen" accessibility option in the settings: This lets you adjust the level of visual sharpening/chromatic aberration (post-processing effects). You can choose between 3 levels: [off/half/normal], in case these effects cause any issues.
[*]Frogs now won’t follow Naiad when transitioning to the next level, providing visual feedback that they should remain in their area, unlike the fishes.

—

[b]There was an unusual bug reported by a player who couldn’t play the game at all due to no input response from the player character at the start of the game.[/b]

[*]This was caused by a missing xInput library on Windows 7. Thanks to the player’s cooperation, sharing log files and recorded videos, I was able to quickly fix the issue! I really appreciate their involvement and patience!.

—

[b]I have taken note of all your feedback. But unfortunately, I haven’t been able to address all of the suggested changes yet. Some suggestions require more development time and testing thoroughly to ensure nothing else gets broken. I will continue working on future updates with all of this in mind:[/b]

[*]Sun-Rays spots: Always show the growing sequence (even after completing the game).
[*]Input remapping and support for non-QWERTY keyboards.
[*]Guitar puzzle improvement.
[*]Input: Tank controls.
[*]And more to come...! 


—

[h2]Thanks for all your positive and helpful reviews![/h2]

I have read all the reviews, paying special attention to suggestions for improvement. 
It really means a lot! 

It's really exciting to see that some players have already completed the game with all achievements. That's simply amazing!

All your positive reviews, comments and feedback support me a lot to keep working on creating games.

[i]THANK YOU! <3[/i]
Elwin

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41481868/73d9af5b0bf771157531eafea538503a775a3ac8.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Coming back with BIG NEWS!
notes.content:
[h2]Hello![/h2]

[h3]This update is very special for me. Because NAIAD is finally getting ready to be released very soon![/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41481868/003e415af0448c1936337590903f1a433c1e4e09.gif[/img]

[h3]After all the time I've dedicated to creating this game, this is a very exciting and meaningful moment![/h3]

[h3]And I have some good news that I can't wait to share with you...[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41481868/356993370a5f84bc08723c71c343ab116374fcea.gif[/img]

[h3]In just a few days, there will be news about the official release date! [/h3]

[h3]Don’t miss the next [b]WholesomeSnack[/b] event on [url=https://www.hiwarp.com/press/NAIADxWholesomeSnack.ics]December 10th at 12pm PT / 3pm ET[/url]. There will be many exciting announcements, exclusive trailers, and... NAIAD will also be part of it![/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41481868/38f60dfa9967c3ca6843e40bc2bb566e58c0cd90.gif[/img]

[h3]A game entirely created by a solo developer... [/h3]

It’s been over a year since my last update here, and first of all, I wanted to apologize for my absence.

During all this time, I’ve been fully focused on the continuous development of the game, putting all my effort into improving and completing the experience in NAIAD. This has involved making some decisions, like stepping back from social media a bit (which, honestly, has been somewhat confusing and overwhelming lately).

Meanwhile, a few people expressed that the project had been canceled and that the game wasn't progressing. Despite my messages clarifying that this wasn’t the case, others might have assumed the worst. On the other hand, I’ve received many supportive messages/emails showing interest in NAIAD and in the developer behind it. I can't thank you enough! These words mean the world to me.

NAIAD has not only NOT been canceled, in fact, it has progressed more than ever. I haven’t stopped working, always making sure to put my very best into this game. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41481868/390b42af1c88d096f64db20c5de283f70841864f.gif[/img]

[h3]In addition to continuing to care for every detail...:[/h3]

[list]
[*] A lot of new content has been added.
[*] New areas to explore.
[*] Hidden secrets to discover.
[*] The visual appearance has been further improved.
[*] NAIAD can now learn new skills, such as breaking rocks by singing, and more!
[*] Many levels have been redesigned and completed to include more things to do. 
[*] More behaviors for the humans and animals.
[*] Many more humans have been added, including small puzzles to solve.
[*] UI redesign and improvement.
[*] The overall experience has been reviewed, finishing up the integration of certain mechanics and features.
[*] Many bugs and issues have been fixed. Thank you for all your feedback!
[*] The optimization process has required months of adjustments and modifications to ensure that NAIAD runs as smoothly and comfortably as possible.
[*] Also I've been working hard to bring the game to all platforms. 
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41481868/50a641ee424112e51ea5b134483c36e96abfec68.gif[/img]

[h3]Right now, I'm preparing to share more updates soon, with details about progress, feature updates, and new content.[/h3]

[h3]As a preview of what's to come...:[/h3]
[*] In addition to the game, the original soundtrack will be released, with over an hour and a half of music.
[*] NAIAD will be available in 9 languages.
[*] A layer of vibration and haptics has been added to the experience, with special support for DualSense on PC (Windows).
[*] Interesting Steam features have been added, such as achievements and presence.
[*] And many more improvements and surprises...!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41481868/7bf5a8a20382bb2486ed0ac6500919baa24f33ea.gif[/img]

[h3]As a friendly reminder, if you haven't added NAIAD to your wishlist yet, and don't want to miss anything, now is the perfect time to do so! ♥ [/h3]

[h3]Thank you so much for your lovely support and patience while NAIAD is coming.[/h3]

Best regards,  
Elwin.

notes.title: NAIAD DevLog #2 + DEMO (TinyTeams Event)
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41481868/4cb8d13775b2ffa3e077787f5094a2bc28d58775.jpg[/img]

[H3]Naiad DEMO + TinyTeams[/h3]

It's very exciting for me to announce that Naiad is part of the TinyTeams event with a DEMO during these days! Visit the event page here: [url=https://store.steampowered.com/sale/tinyteamsfestival2023]tinyteamsfestival2023[/url]

Don't miss the chance to follow the event, enjoy offers, play exclusive demos and watch the streaming of many interesting games.

[url=bit.ly/naiadgame][b]NAIAD DEMO is now available to download and PLAY![/b][/url]


[h3]DEVLOG #2:[/h3]

Thanks to all of you who have taken the time to write about your experience and sensations playing Naiad. 

[b]These are some of the improvements and news:[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41481868/91afd77113b1d15603e796b725bd97035242b371.gif[/img]

[h2]Improved controls + Mouse support:[/h2]
I finally managed to spend some time to extend and improve the controls on PC, which I hope will allow more people to play more comfortably and easily. 

- With the [b]new mouse support[/b] it is now possible to manage both the menu interface and options, as well as the character control. 
- Options have been added to switch the keys between two predefined modes (right-handed and left-handed), so you can use the arrow keys or the 'WASD' keys.
- The controls screen shows a visual graphic for each control in use, automatically.
- The handling of the character has been adjusted to be more agile, without losing the dragging effect of swimming in the water.
- When using the keyboard to move the character, a small arrow appears as a guide to help the player better understand the direction.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41481868/b73f51440d24845e56391123c19ea7e870f6981c.gif[/img]

[h2]Interface design:[/h2]
Taking advantage of all the necessary changes to make mouse interaction with the interface possible, I have also been improving and extending features in the menu screens with new, prettier, more intuitive and optimized elements. All this with the aim of making the game as smooth as possible.

- New screens with elements to discover during the adventure.
- Graphics that are painted when changing screen.
- A new and better type of buttons.
- Interface that warns before finishing each level to allow the player to go back and explore more before going down the river.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41481868/0592b61c6fbf46113cf826d503f87b94614b0134.gif[/img]

[h2]More animals, more behaviors:[/h2]
One of the keys of Naiad is the interaction with the friends that you find in the wildlife and nature. Since the initial concept of the game, there have been many ideas that I would love to include in the game. From additional animals to find to fun puzzles. Some of the new features are:

- New additional animals such as jellyfish, octopus and squid that are fun to swim with, and more!.
- Certain animals found on the shore, such as rabbits, can now climb onto medium-sized wooden logs floating in the water and thus be transported in a kind of "mini-boat". 
- Interaction with frogs has been improved to make it easier for them to follow you.
- More animations when certain animals land on a place, such as butterflies on flowers, frogs on water lilies, ...

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41481868/d5af5c0f6120a26c7651355abb3ab3bff1aed985.gif[/img]

[h2]Music in harmony[/h2]
- Did you know that Naiad contains over 60 different pieces of music? All of them have been revised to match Naiad's singing during the game.
- In addition to the music that can be heard in each of the levels, there are some special melodies to discover and learn to sing.

[h3]Thank you so much for playing, supporting and making Naiad possible![/h3]


[i]Kind regards,
Elwin[/i]

notes.title: NAIAD DevLog #1
notes.content:
[h3]Hi! It's been almost a year since the presentation of Naiad playable demo at Steam Next Fest last June 2022. It was a great experience for me as solo-dev and creator of this very personal game about flowing down a river and taking care of nature.[/h3]

Many wonderful things have happened during this time! Thanks to some nice opportunities, thanks to all your wonderful appreciation and your great support with lovely feedback and comments, the game will be able to include [b]many new improvements and content[/b]. 

[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/41481868/980653bc11278303c8906368ee4651062c093233.gif[/img]

[h3]While the development continues, I would like to share with you [b]some of the new features[/b] that will expand and enhance the game experience in Naiad.[/h3]

[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/41481868/7037ee6ba7dc5c7e8052e54e2f7bf4ff8954c1a8.png[/img]

[h2]Flow with flying birds[/h2]
New animals have been added to discover and interact with. There were already many adorable friends in the water (fish, frogs, ducklings, ...) and on the ground near the river (bunnies, deer, sheep, ...). 

In addition to some butterflies, bees, dragonflies, ..., there are now also [b]birds flying by the air[/b], such beautiful hummingbirds, hawk, flamingos, and more! 

It's a really nice [b]flowing moment[/b] when you get close to them, swimming as they fly.

[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/41481868/716a092ebe885a8436adcb6893e5493f37ec4664.gif[/img]

[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/41481868/7037ee6ba7dc5c7e8052e54e2f7bf4ff8954c1a8.png[/img]

[h2]Higher up in the trees[/h2]

I have been iteratively extending this [b]top-down layered river world[/b]. From the far deep waters to the sky closer to the player's eyes, there is a lot of new stuff. 

[b]Explore taller branches[/b] to find even more secrets, such as this curious and [b]tiny mouse[/b]. Play here to solve little puzzles.
 
[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/41481868/13ffca3f76b60734925707761c918e4a57b41973.gif[/img]

[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/41481868/7037ee6ba7dc5c7e8052e54e2f7bf4ff8954c1a8.png[/img]

[h2]Finding adorable friends[/h2]
Now in the [b]"map" view[/b], there is a new side panel with little images of the fauna that has been discovered in each area. 

I'm trying to keep the game from being a list of things to complete or a race to the end, avoiding typical rewards or collective elements as much as possible, that could stop the player from flowing at their own pace. I hope you will find these kinds of stuff friendly.

[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/41481868/3e851d590f7cdaa128973ff117bc3b446d180039.gif[/img]

[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/41481868/7037ee6ba7dc5c7e8052e54e2f7bf4ff8954c1a8.png[/img]

[h2]New colorful biomes[/h2]
Throughout the [b]16 episodes[/b] that shape Naiad journey, the sections across the river have been further extended with more content and areas to discover. 

Some levels or parts have been completely [b]redesigned[/b], with visual improvements, small challenges, new fauna and flora, colorful biomes to enrich the view.

[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/41481868/df3deaa3eeb42cd654a280219af64c6c38409283.gif[/img]

[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/41481868/7037ee6ba7dc5c7e8052e54e2f7bf4ff8954c1a8.png[/img]

[h2]Strange artifacts[/h2]

Along the river more [b]human-related elements[/b] were created. Gradually, Naiad will have to face more [b]obstacles[/b], and the presence of those who, in their self-interest, have forgotten the importance of caring for nature.

[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/41481868/ca49fb683cf8178001afa9c4ac847a29d09177f0.gif[/img]

[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/41481868/7037ee6ba7dc5c7e8052e54e2f7bf4ff8954c1a8.png[/img]

[h2]A forgotten language[/h2]
I have been working on an [b]alternative storyline and ending[/b], which have already been integrated into the game. 

[b][i]The legend tells of an extinct language, which hides the secrets of nature itself. [/i][/b]

Inspired by the river, these strange and indecipherable glyphs hold a meaning known only by the clouds. On your journey, explore even [b]more distant and secret areas[/b], and with luck you will uncover a hidden story.

[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/41481868/07ac1fafd0d00f2df47f54dcdff8a5eb3cc41d9f.gif[/img]

[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/41481868/7037ee6ba7dc5c7e8052e54e2f7bf4ff8954c1a8.png[/img]

[h2]More Naiad news are coming soon![/h2]

I am doing my best creating this game using only my own resources. It is a lot of work for one person, but I think this is one of the things I appreciate the most about indie games.

[b]I hope to be able to self-publish Naiad on PC and consoles towards the end of 2023. [/b]

[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/41481868/d6fba55a14773157a8c263ab820c4a2c2a54cc5a.gif[/img]

[h3]Thank you again for all your great support and patience![/h3]

[i]Kind regards,
Elwin[/i]
